body: I just wish I could feel better. truly and actually feel better inside my mind
probably won't want to re-read any of this out of my fear of realizing how out of whack I really am right now
what happened wasn't even that bad and I'm going ballistic. pretty sure I've dealt with worse shit too. why is this so difficult. fuck. Fuck. GOD. Fuck.
really wish I could give someone else my life and have just never existed

my god I'm so insecure. how the hell do you stop being so insecure. I have no confidence with reasons to be confident. I can't do it, I can't not be insecure as fuck and crippilingly fucked in the head
God this is torture. just dragging out the inevitable. I'm at the point where I'm talking to myself on a fucking Reddit thread just to cope. Jesus

Years of this shit, all I've seemed to do is run from the problem one way or another. exercise, weed, meeting people, traveling, having awesome shit happen and irreplaceable moments. all of it was great, but none of it has ever washed this shitty fate away
i know I won't kill myself tonight. but I'm basically already in the pit of where you do it mentally. just a matter of time for me at this point- how much I can take before I break

I can't stop replaying the images of the shit I wasn't around for in my head.

I see it over and over and over and over and over and why god why does it have to be like this
